commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: expressive original animal mascot PNG for Japanese character diagnosis site Stella File.
Input image: visual STYLE reference. Match its illustration language and cozy warm palette, but design a DISTINCT expression. Do not reuse the bear's raised worried eyebrows and little asymmetric mouth.
Primary request: One original animal in the same series as the bear, with its PERSONALITY immediately readable from face and pose.
Style/medium: warm gentle 2D digital illustration, exceptionally large broad rounded head and tiny squat body, chubby paws, thick smooth dark chocolate-brown outlines and rounded ends. Quiet empty forehead, face low on the head. Matte warm colors with very subtle soft shading. Head ~65–70% of total height excluding ears. Small simple eyes (dots, crescents, half-lidded shapes or wink as specified), distinct expressive eyebrows and mouth. Expressive simple cartoon face, warm and cute, coherent with reference.
Composition: full-body centered square canvas, comfortable margins, all ears, paws, fins, tails visible, no cropping. Front or slight three-quarter angle unless specified. Only the requested animal and its specified tiny props.
Background: genuinely transparent with clean alpha edges. No ground shadow, card, scenery, text, label or watermark. Cream parts ON the animal stay opaque.
Constraints: consistent outline, proportions and color finish, with diversity in brows, eyes, mouth and pose. Anatomically readable animal. No bear ears on other animals. No photorealism, 3D, detailed fur, glossy rendering or giant shiny anime eyes.

characters.name: ちゃっかりうさぎ
characters.expression: いたずらっぽいウインク・片手を上げたちゃっかり顔
characters.description: Pale ivory rabbit, huge broad rounded head, two long broad round-tipped peach-lined ears, tiny compact body and round feet. Small leaf-green four-leaf clover near ear and tiny green flower at chest. Clever sociable cheeky expression: one brown dot eye open and other CLEARLY WINKING, one raised brow, visible jaunty wide smile, soft peach cheeks. Playful head tilt. One paw raised greeting, other at hip, one foot lightly lifted.

Quiet empty forehead, face placed low on the head. Matte warm colors with the reference's very subtle soft shading. Head ~65–70% of total height excluding ears. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha edges. No ground shadow, no card, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark. Cream areas ON the animal stay opaque.

Subject: pale ivory rabbit, huge broad rounded head, two long broad round-tipped ears with peach inner ears, tiny compact body and round feet. Small leaf-green four-leaf clover tucked near one ear and tiny green flower at chest. PERSONALITY AND FACE: clever sociable, adorably cheeky; ONE EYE OPEN as a dark-brown dot, OTHER EYE CLEARLY WINKING as an angled curved line, one gently raised eyebrow, a visible jaunty wide sideways smile, soft peach cheeks. Head tilts playfully a little. One short paw raised in a jaunty greeting, other paw resting at hip, one foot lightly lifted. The wink and playful smile must clearly differ from the bear's timid face. Warm ivory, subtle green accents.

characters.name: 勝手に主役フェニックス
characters.expression: 三日月目と満面の笑顔・翼を高く広げる
characters.description: Cute warm coral-red baby phoenix, huge broad rounded head, three-feather rounded red-and-gold crest, golden-yellow rounded beak, cream belly, tiny squat bird body, gold feet and round red-and-gold tail feathers. Jubilant natural star: BOTH EYES HAPPY UPSIDE-DOWN U CRESCENTS, WIDELY OPEN SMILING golden beak with tiny coral tongue, raised cheerful brows, rosy cheeks. Tiny wings lifted outward and upward celebrating, lightly bouncing above a tiny ochre oval stage. Visibly energetic face, no worried brows, not neutral.

characters.name: お見通し妖狐
characters.expression: 半目の観察眼・片眉を上げた余裕のある微笑み
characters.description: Calm ivory fox, huge broad rounded head, rounded triangular vermilion-lined ears, cream muzzle, tiny brown nose. ONE large curled vermilion tail with cream tip by tiny seated body. Quietly perceptive and confident: SMALL HALF-LIDDED BROWN EYES glance sideways, one eyebrow delicately raised, clearly knowing sideways smile, slight head tilt. One paw near cheek thoughtfully, other at belly. Tiny candle in clay holder near feet. Red brow accents integrated with brows. Friendly wit, no sadness or anger.

characters.name: 親分パンダ
characters.expression: どっしりした自信顔・片眉を上げて大きくにっこり
characters.description: Broad reassuring ivory-and-soft charcoal panda, huge round wide head, round ears, charcoal eye patches, small brown dot eyes, tiny brown nose. Small round seated body, charcoal paws and feet, cream belly. Holds tiny mustard-yellow teacup low at belly. Relaxed confident dependable boss: broad warm U-shaped OPEN GRIN with tiny pink tongue, one raised brow, other easy level brow, kindly looking at viewer. Chin slightly up, feet comfortably spread, solid relaxed posture. Thick DARK BROWN outlines even around charcoal. Openly reassuring, not bashful.

characters.name: ほっとけないアルパカ
characters.expression: 子どもを見守るやさしい目・少し心配そうな微笑み
characters.description: Golden-cream fluffy alpaca, huge broad head, rounded fluffy topknot, two short banana-shaped ears, short but VISIBLE fluffy neck, tiny compact rounded four-legged body. Fur only a few broad scallops. Cream muzzle, tiny brown nose. Much smaller baby alpaca snuggled at side below parent's head, BOTH full bodies visible. Tender caretaker: parent tilts head toward baby, small soft brown eyes glance down, brows curved in mild concern, tender little affectionate smile. One front hoof softly around baby's shoulder. Baby looks up with delighted crescent eyes and tiny smile. Alpaca silhouette, not bear.

characters.name: 正々堂々ドーベルマン
characters.expression: まっすぐな目ときりっとした眉・胸を張る誠実な顔
characters.description: Friendly silver-gray doberman, huge broad rounded head, natural soft floppy ears to sides, cream muzzle, small tan brow patches, tiny brown nose. Tiny upright seated dog body, rounded forepaws and feet. Steel-blue collar, tiny gold shield badge. Earnest principled guardian: small open brown eyes straight ahead, firm inward-slanting brows read DETERMINED BUT KIND, small confident smile slightly lifted at one corner, chin up, chest proudly out, forepaws planted firmly. Abbreviated soft doberman muzzle. No aggression, teeth, angry grimace, cropped pointy ears or flag.

characters.expression: 照れた頬と不安げな目・ハートを大切に抱きしめる
characters.description: Pearl-ivory hedgehog, huge broad round face framed by a few LARGE ROUNDED muted silver spines, tiny round ears, cream muzzle, brown nose, tiny squat body and round feet. Cradles pale translucent-looking light blue heart tightly at chest. Tiny simple white flower by feet. Shy sensitive protective tenderness: slightly larger simple brown oval eyes with just one tiny cream glint, inner brows raised vulnerably, peach blush, tiny hesitant smile. Head slightly down, shoulders tucked, paws wrap around heart. Rounded spines, no tears, sparkle or realistic fur.

characters.expression: 自信いっぱいの大きな笑顔・勢いよく跳ねる

characters.name: 温泉カピバラ
characters.expression: とろんとした半目・温泉で満足そうにほっとする
characters.description: Warm-tan capybara, huge broad softly squarish rounded head, very tiny rounded ears high up, long broad cream muzzle and broad rounded brown nose low on face. Tiny squat body soaks in simple small clear muted blue oval hot spring, two tiny forepaws relaxed on front water edge. Small green leaf on head, two soft cream steam curls. Deeply peaceful content: both eyes SLEEPY HALF-CLOSED HORIZONTAL CURVES, soft relaxed flat brows, satisfied little U smile, peach cheeks, head slightly slumped in relaxation. Recognizably capybara through tiny ears and long blunt muzzle, not bear. No scenery/pool rocks.
